text: Cohen's 1963 forcing argument established which relative-consistency result?
choices: that CH is provable in ZFC
explanation: Cohen used forcing to prove $\mathrm{Con}(\mathrm{ZF}) \Rightarrow \mathrm{Con}(\mathrm{ZFC}+\neg\mathrm{CH})$, so CH is NOT provable from ZFC. The first option is Godel's constructible-universe result (the complementary half, giving consistency of GCH). Together they make CH independent, and both results assume, rather than refute, the consistency of ZFC.
